_readme: Relevance is marked by an `evidence` snippet, not by a chunk index.
Chunk indices shift the moment chunking changes (T9), which would make this
file meaningless exactly when it is needed most. A retrieved chunk counts as
relevant when it contains the evidence text, compared with whitespace
`answer` is unused by the retrieval metrics; it is there for RAGAS (T23).

questions.question: How much paid annual leave do full-time staff get each year?
questions.answer: 22 days per calendar year.

questions.question: What happens to leave I do not use by the end of the year?
questions.answer: Up to 8 days carry over; the rest is forfeited on 31 January.

questions.question: When do I need a doctor's note for being off sick?
questions.answer: From the fourth consecutive day of absence.

questions.question: How long is leave for a new parent who is the main carer?
questions.answer: 18 weeks at full pay for the primary caregiver.

questions.question: Which policy covers parental leave requests?
questions.answer: Policy HR-204.

questions.question: What does policy HR-311 govern?
questions.answer: Unpaid sabbatical, available after four years of service.

questions.question: What is the daily food allowance when travelling in the US?
questions.answer: Up to $75 per day in North America.

questions.question: How much can a new joiner spend setting up a desk at home?
questions.answer: Up to $1,200 in the first year.

questions.question: What is the exception code for a late expense claim?
questions.answer: Exception code FIN-88.

questions.question: Which asset class is the standard engineering laptop?
questions.answer: Asset class LT-4471.

questions.question: What laptop does the design team use?
questions.answer: Asset class LT-5290, with a colour-calibrated display.

questions.question: What happens if I lose my company laptop?
questions.answer: Charged at depreciated value under policy IT-119.

questions.question: Can I buy my old laptop when it gets replaced?
questions.answer: Yes, at 15% of the original price.

questions.question: How long must my password be?
questions.answer: At least 14 characters.

questions.question: Who do I call about a security problem out of hours?
questions.answer: The on-call security engineer on extension 4402.

questions.question: How many days a week can I work from home?
questions.answer: Up to three days per week.

questions.question: Do I have to tell anyone if I work from abroad for a month?
questions.answer: Yes, People Operations must be notified in advance.

questions.question: How do I tell a test key from a real one?
questions.answer: Sandbox keys start with sk_test_ and production keys with sk_live_.

questions.question: What should I send support so they can find my failed call?
questions.answer: The X-Request-Id header value.

questions.question: How many calls am I allowed per hour by default?
questions.answer: 1,000 requests per hour per token.

questions.question: How do I know how long to wait after being throttled?
questions.answer: The Retry-After header gives the wait in seconds.

questions.question: Why am I throttled when I still have hourly quota left?
questions.answer: Burst traffic is smoothed over a 60-second window.

questions.question: How do I avoid charging a customer twice on a retry?
questions.answer: Send an idempotency_key; replays within 24 hours return the original response.

questions.question: How late can a payment still be refunded?
questions.answer: Within 180 days of the original charge.

questions.question: How are webhook payloads signed?
questions.answer: With HMAC-SHA256, in the Meridian-Signature header.

questions.question: How long do you keep retrying a webhook that fails?
questions.answer: Exponential backoff for 72 hours, then the event is dropped.

questions.question: When does money from a local sale actually arrive?
questions.answer: Two business days for domestic transactions.

questions.question: What error do I get for sending 10.50 as an amount?
questions.answer: HTTP 400 with error code amount_not_integer.

questions.question: How long was ingestion broken?
questions.answer: 4 hours and 12 minutes.

questions.question: How serious was the outage rated?
questions.answer: SEV-2.

questions.question: How many uploads had to be replayed afterwards?
questions.answer: 1,847 uploads were queued and replayed.

questions.question: What actually caused the failure?
questions.answer: The connection pool was cut from 32 to 4 while worker concurrency stayed at 16.

questions.question: Why did staging not catch this before release?
questions.answer: Staging runs one worker at concurrency 2, which four connections serve fine.

questions.question: How much time was lost chasing the wrong theory?
questions.answer: About 25 minutes, spent rate-limiting an unrelated bulk import.

questions.question: What is being done so this cannot happen again?
questions.answer: AI-1 adds a startup assertion that pool size is at least worker concurrency.

questions.question: Who owns the dashboard change and when is it due?
questions.answer: The observability team, due 4 April.

questions.question: রাজবাড়ী জেলার ইতিহাস কী?
questions.evidence: রাজবাড়ী পদ্মা নদী ও রেল যোগাযোগ
questions.answer: পদ্মা নদী ও রেল যোগাযোগের কারণে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হয়ে ওঠে।

questions.question: বাংলাদেশের প্রাচীনতম নগর কোথায়?
questions.answer: বগুড়ায় অবস্থিত মহাস্থানগড়, প্রাচীন পুণ্ড্রনগর।

questions.question: সুন্দরবনের প্রবেশদ্বার কোন জেলা?
questions.answer: খুলনা।

questions.question: চা বাগানের জন্য কোন জেলা বিখ্যাত?
questions.answer: সিলেট।

questions.question: রেশম শিল্পের জন্য পরিচিত জেলা কোনটি?
questions.answer: রাজশাহী।

questions.question: রানী ভবানী কোন জেলার সাথে সম্পর্কিত?
questions.answer: নাটোর।

questions.question: কর্ণফুলী নদীর তীরে কোন শহর?
questions.answer: চট্টগ্রাম।

questions.question: বাংলাদেশে মোট কতটি জেলা আছে?
questions.answer: ৬৪টি জেলা, আটটি বিভাগে বিভক্ত।

questions.question: আয়তনে সবচেয়ে ছোট জেলা কোনটি?
questions.answer: মেহেরপুর।

questions.question: ময়নামতি ও শালবন বিহার কোথায়?
questions.answer: কুমিল্লায়।

questions.question: শস্যভাণ্ডার নামে পরিচিত জেলা কোনটি?
questions.answer: বরিশাল।

questions.question: তিস্তা নদীবিধৌত জেলা কোনটি?
questions.answer: রংপুর।
